title: Cute Cottage Apartment Downtown
description:
Located extremely convenient to downtown. 1/2 mile from the heart of Germantown. Very walkable.  Easy, cheap ride share to all Nashville attractions with a bus (WE GO that stops within .1 mile (just up the street) from the unit’s door and  connects to baseball park/farmers market, the capitol/courthouse end of downtown. This is a newly renovated unit and everything in it is new.  It is located near the campuses of Fisk University and Meharry Medical college next to historic Jefferson Street.

The space
Wonderful renovated cottage consisting of two separate living units. You will stay in 1107, a one bedroom, one bath residence. It is comfortable for two traveling together and cozy as separate or more than two. The living room has a Serta sleeper sofa along with two ottoman cots that that are sturdy and comfortable.  All linens for these are in the end cabinet in the living room/kitchen area (see pics).

Guest access
You will have your own unit. The only shared space is the backyard. Please  use the deck and backyard while you stay. There is a seating and a chiminea fire pit in the backyard  along with a supply of wood under the deck.

Free and convenient on-premise parking in driveway/yard...just a few short steps from front door.

Other things to note
The tv is a smart tv and has an antenna (many channels come in clearly) and access to the usual apps. My Hulu account is linked and that has access to most networks including ESPN).   The house is wifi enabled with high speed fiber.   Spotify can be played through the TV as well.

Unit and neighborhood is quite considering the proximity to Broadway and downtown.  No train noise. 

Home has cool quirky, yet comfortable vibe. Extremely clean.
